primary.title: Estimating pi(x) and related functions under partial RH assumptions
primary.author: Jan Büthe
primary.locator: Theorem2, FIRST UNNUMBERED psi estimate, printedp13/PDF13
primary.recoverable_claim: Partial RH up toT>0 and4.92sqrt(x/logx)≤T imply |psi(x)−x|≤sqrt(x)log²x/(8pi), x>59.
primary.not_the_psi_locator: Eq7.1 is the Riemann prime-power count; Eq7.2 is ordinary pi.
primary.source_convention: §2, printedp2, defines half weight at a prime-power endpoint.

actual_formal_contract_display_tex: \begin{gathered}\mathrm{RH}_{\le T},\quad x>59,\quad4.92\sqrt{x/\log x}\le T\quad\Longrightarrow\quad|\psi(x)-x|\le\frac{\sqrt x\log^2x}{8\pi},\\\mathrm{RH}\Longrightarrow\mathrm{RH}_{\le T}\text{ for every finite }T,\qquad T(x)=4.92\sqrt{x/\log x}.\end{gathered}

precise_boundary.formal_input: The unchanged Lean source proposition uses ordinary Chebyshev.psi and remains an explicit B-tier hypothesis, not a newly proved translation of every partial-height endpoint case.
precise_boundary.consumed_full_RH_path: FullRH.buthe_all_psi uses the unchanged input with T=4.92sqrt(x/logx), then ThetaRelay consumes it on the whole ray.
precise_boundary.mathematical_source_consequence: Under full RH, non-prime-power points decreasing to x from above, with individually enlarged heights, recover the ordinary right-count psi bound by continuity of the displayed envelope.
precise_boundary.not_claimed: No new formal fixed-height endpoint adapter; no source binder change.
precise_boundary.positive_height: Forx>59 the range condition itself forcesT>0.
